announcements.headline: Novo Nordisk A/S - share repurchase programme
announcements.insight: The share repurchase programme is announced again in November, following earlier filings this month. This indicates ongoing capital return activities.

announcements.headline: Novo Nordisk A/S - share repurchase programme
announcements.insight: The share repurchase programme continues following earlier filings in November. This ongoing buyback activity suggests continued capital return to shareholders.

announcements.headline: Novo commits USD 200 million over 10 years to support the World Diabetes Foundation to strengthen diabetes prevention and care
announcements.insight: This charitable commitment follows recent strong financial results and share buybacks. It has no direct financial impact on shareholders.

announcements.headline: Novo Nordisk A/S - share repurchase programme
announcements.insight: Novo Nordisk A/S Class B (0QIU) announces a share repurchase programme. This follows an earlier repurchase filing in November 2026.

announcements.headline: Novo Nordisk A/S: Trading in Novo Nordisk shares by board members, executives and associated persons
announcements.insight: Board members and executives have traded shares. This follows recent guidance raises and a share repurchase programme.

announcements.headline: Novo raises full-year outlook on continued GLP-1 momentum, with third-quarter adjusted operating profit increasing 27% at CER to DKK 31,720 million
announcements.insight: Novo Nordisk raises full-year outlook on continued GLP-1 momentum. This follows earlier updates on CagriSema and Wegovy efficacy.

announcements.headline: Novo Nordisk A/S - share repurchase programme
announcements.insight: Share repurchases return capital to investors. This follows recent clinical updates for CagriSema and Wegovy.

announcements.headline: Novo provides update on the denecimig Biologics License Application (BLA) in the US
announcements.insight: Novo provides an update on the denecimig BLA in the US. This follows earlier highlights of CagriSema’s superior weight loss and reduced liver fat.

announcements.headline: Novo’s Wegovy® (semaglutide) reduced liver fat to normal levels in 9 out of 10 adults with obesity and excess liver fat – EASD2026
announcements.insight: Novo Nordisk A/S Class B (0QIU) presents data showing Wegovy reduced liver fat in most patients. This complements earlier updates on CagriSema and Sogroya progress.

announcements.headline: Novo’s investigational obesity and diabetes drug CagriSema reduces ‘food noise’ and shows benefits in organ and bone health – EASD 2026
announcements.insight: CagriSema shows superior weight loss versus tirzepatide in REIMAGINE 5. This supports its potential as a key obesity and diabetes treatment alongside other recent pipeline developments.

announcements.headline: Novo and UNICEF expand partnership to support a healthier start for more than 80 million children
announcements.insight: Novo Nordisk expands a partnership to support children. This follows recent drug approvals and trial results presented at its Capital Markets Day.

announcements.headline: Novo's CagriSema delivers superior weight loss versus tirzepatide in REIMAGINE 5 trial
announcements.insight: Novo Nordisk A/S Class B reports CagriSema outperforms tirzepatide in REIMAGINE 5. This follows recent CHMP recommendations for FREHEMGO and Sogroya, reinforcing its pipeline progress.

announcements.headline: Highlights to be presented at Novo’s Capital Markets Day 2026
announcements.insight: Novo Nordisk A/S Class B will present highlights at its Capital Markets Day 2026. This follows recent regulatory approvals and AI collaboration announcements.

announcements.headline: Novo’s once-weekly Sogroya® (somapacitan) receives positive CHMP opinion in Europe for children with idiopathic short stature (unexplained shortness)
announcements.insight: Positive CHMP opinion for Sogroya expands the pipeline beyond obesity treatments mentioned in September. This regulatory milestone supports Novo Nordisk’s broader cardiometabolic strategy.

announcements.headline: Novo: CHMP recommends EU approval of FREHEMGO® (denecimig), the first factor VIIIa mimetic offering monthly, once every two weeks and weekly dosing in a pre-filled pen, for the treatment of haemophilia A
announcements.insight: CHMP recommendation for FREHEMGO advances Novo Nordisk's haemophilia pipeline. This complements their broader therapeutic focus seen in recent obesity and cardiometabolic data releases.

announcements.headline: Novo and Anthropic will collaborate to advance drug discovery with Claude
announcements.insight: Novo follows its August AWS partnership by collaborating with Anthropic to advance drug discovery using Claude. This extends their AI-driven research efforts.

announcements.headline: Novo to share real-world and clinical data including Wegovy® pill, and cardiometabolic pipeline progress with next-generation amylin treatments at EASD 2026
announcements.insight: Novo Nordisk shares real-world data for its pill and pipeline progress at EASD 2026. This follows recent STEP Young phase 3 results and an AWS AI partnership.

announcements.headline: Novo Nordisk enters next chapter to bring better health to more people, supported by ‘Novo’ rebrand and updated corporate culture
announcements.insight: Novo Nordisk rebrands to 'Novo' and updates its culture following strong Q2 results and a Dutch court injunction. This supports ongoing commercial momentum.

announcements.headline: Novo Nordisk STEP Young phase 3 data: 40.4% of children living with obesity achieved a BMI below the obesity threshold with semaglutide and lifestyle modification
announcements.insight: New phase 3 data for semaglutide in children expands the obesity addressable market. This complements the August sales and profit outlook raise.

announcements.headline: Novo Nordisk and AWS enter strategic partnership to accelerate drug discovery through AI
announcements.insight: Novo Nordisk partners with AWS to accelerate drug discovery via AI. This follows recent sales outlook upgrades and court actions protecting patients from unlawful competition.

announcements.headline: Novo Nordisk wins Dutch court injunction protecting patients from unapproved, unlawful compounded semaglutide nasal spray
announcements.insight: Following July advertising actions, this injunction protects patients from unlawful compounded semaglutide nasal spray, reinforcing product integrity alongside recent Q2 profit guidance.

announcements.headline: Novo Nordisk reports adjusted operating profit of DKK 33,389 million for Q2 2026 and raises full-year outlook
announcements.insight: Novo Nordisk raises its full-year outlook following earlier guidance updates in August. This confirms strong execution of its global expansion and product launch strategy.

announcements.headline: Novo Nordisk raises adjusted sales and adjusted operating profit outlook for 2026
announcements.insight: Novo Nordisk raises adjusted sales and operating profit outlook for 2026. This follows recent updates on global access to obesity care and clinical trial progress.

announcements.headline: Novo Nordisk provides update on the ZEUS phase 3 trial in people with ASCVD, CKD and inflammation
announcements.insight: Novo Nordisk provides an update on the ZEUS phase 3 trial. This follows recent global expansion of Wegovy pill access in June.

announcements.headline: Novo Nordisk takes action to stop multiple misleading national GLP-1 advertising campaigns by Eli Lilly
announcements.insight: Novo Nordisk takes action to stop multiple misleading national GLP-1 advertising campaigns by Eli Lilly. This is a competitive matter rather than an operational update for Novo Nordisk.

announcements.headline: Novo Nordisk: Wegovy® pill (semaglutide tablets) becomes first daily GLP-1 weight-loss pill approved in the UK
announcements.insight: Novo Nordisk A/S Class B sees UK approval of its daily GLP-1 weight-loss pill, following a June UAE launch. This expands regional access to obesity care.

announcements.headline: Wegovy® pill launches in the UAE as Novo Nordisk expands global access to obesity care
announcements.insight: Wegovy pill launches in UAE. Shareholders should monitor global expansion progress.
